scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.apk:build: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && set CLOUD_API_URL=%CLOUD_API_URL% && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release
